cells.forex: Mainly the [[spread]], sometimes a commission, plus [[swap|overnight swaps]] on positions held past the daily cut-off.
cells.stocks: Spread and commission, which vary by broker; holding with your own cash has no financing charge.
cells.penny_stocks: Spreads can be a large share of the price, so getting in and out can cost a lot before price moves.
cells.commodities: Spread and commission, plus storage-related costs built into the product, such as roll costs in futures.
cells.futures: Commission and exchange fees per contract, the spread, and the cost of rolling to a later month.

caveat: Costs depend on the broker, account type, product, size, time of day and conditions. Measure them on a demo or in the simulator at the times you would trade.
